title: Aromatic Slow-Cooked Saudi-Arabian Beef Brisket Hash
description: A delicious, low-glycemic-friendly weeknight dish featuring beef brisket, cooked in a Bain Marie using an iron teppan vessel. The sweet and crunchy flavors make it a perfect dinner option.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in the iron teppan vessel over medium heat.
Sear the beef brisket for 2 minutes on each side, then set aside.
In the same vessel, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil, followed by the sliced onions. Cook until the onions are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the vessel and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the vessel and stir to combine.
Place the beef brisket back into the vessel, followed by the sliced potatoes and diced tomatoes.
Transfer the vessel to a Bain Marie and cook for 2.5 hours at 275°F (135°C).
After 2 hours, stir the hash gently to redistribute the ingredients.
Continue cooking for another 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the beef is fall-apart tender.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
